<description>
This is a small linter to reject confusingly named RPC arg names or RPC result fields. Generally, such names should be `snake_case`. Otherwise, there are [bugs and confusion](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35317#issue-4473659957).

For now, write a C++20 `consteval` linter that still accepts `MiXed_cAse`. In the future, it can be made stricter.
</description>
